headline: 耳语人领跑电影，绿灯军团霸屏剧集
headlineEn: Whisperer leads films, Green Lantern Corps dominates TV
summary: 今日零新片，但《耳语人》继续领跑电影热度；剧集方面《绿灯军团》强势登顶。本周共6部新片，暂无后续重磅定档。
summaryEn: No new releases today, but The Whisperer keeps leading movie buzz; Green Lantern Corps tops TV charts. Six new films this week, no major upcoming dates yet.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周共有6部新片。
industryHighlights.en: No new movies released today; 6 new movies this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》与《末日地堡》领跑本周剧集热度。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps and Silo lead the week's TV buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《耳语人》继续稳居电影热度榜首，《奥德赛》持续走高。
industryHighlights.en: The Whisperer remains the top movie trend, while The Odyssey keeps climbing.

industryHighlights.text: 未来暂无重点新片定档。
industryHighlights.en: No major upcoming film releases are scheduled.
